text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I lost...! What in the 
world happened to Shiraoki-sama?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could they be asleep?! Napping during an 
oracle is an absolute no-no!!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best next time.
Maybe our skills are being tested.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Yeaaah... It just wasn't our day, 
so I guess it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I hope they'll be awake next 
time...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! You're saying you wanted to 
see what I could do without relying on 
good luck...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! In that case, aren't these 
results really bad!? What if they're 
totally exasperated with me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I have to make a comeback!! In the next 
race, I must take 1st place... or at least 
2nd place...!

Alongside an inspired Matikanefukukitaru, 
we vowed to achieve victory in our next 
race.
